_comment: Manual-ingest dump of the first live GEO citation baseline, collected 2026-05-31 via You.com Research API (research_effort=lite), one answer engine. Each item is one sampled answer: the engine's prose plus the URLs it cited. Feeds `geo-citation-probe.py --provider manual --ingest`. Repeated prompts are intentional (measure citation variance).
